name: evide-mcp
description: Deposit evidentiary records of AI agent decisions into EVIDE (External Evidentiary Deposit). Requires a DAPI verified identity and an active EVIDE subscription.

settings.name: EVIDE API key
settings.description: Your EVIDE API key. It belongs to the human or organization responsible for the agent, not to the agent.

settings.name: DAPI number
settings.description: The 10-digit DAPI number (verified identity) of the API key owner.

settings.name: Owner ID
settings.description: Your owner identifier in the source system.

settings.name: Agent system (optional)
settings.description: Declared name of the agent system. Leave empty if not declared.

settings.name: Agent ID (optional)
settings.description: Declared identifier of the agent. Leave empty if not declared.
